findings.quote: may also be shared with Riverbend Partner Network members for marketing of additional services and for research
findings.explanation: This section lets the county share your application information with other organizations for marketing and research, not just to process your application.
findings.reason: It goes beyond what's needed to decide your benefits, so you may want to ask your caseworker whether you can say no to it.

findings.quote: you authorize the Riverbend County Department of Human Services to verify your income with your employer, banks, and other agencies
findings.explanation: By signing, you allow the county to check your income with your employer, your bank and other agencies.
findings.reason: They may contact your employer or bank to confirm what you told them.

findings.quote: I certify under penalty of perjury that the information on this application is true and complete
findings.explanation: You are promising, under penalty of perjury, that everything on the application is true.
findings.reason: Giving false information on purpose can lead to legal penalties.

findings.quote: you will have to pay them back, and you may be disqualified from the program
findings.explanation: If you get benefits you shouldn't have, you'll have to repay them and could be removed from the program.
findings.reason: Reporting accurately protects you from having to pay money back.

findings.quote: You must report changes in income of more than $100 within 10 days
findings.explanation: After you're approved, you must report income changes of more than $100 within 10 days.
findings.reason: Missing this deadline can mean repaying benefits.
